summary: 3 E Network Technology Group (Nasdaq: MASK), a Hong Kong-based B2B IT solutions provider, disclosed via Form 6-K that on October 27, 2026 it received a Nasdaq Staff Determination to delist its Class A ordinary shares. Grounds: closing bid below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days (September 15–October 26, 2026) under Rule 5550(a)(2), with no compliance period available because a 1-for-25 reverse split occurred March 16, 2026. The company intends to request a Panel hearing by November 3, 2026, which stays suspension and Form 25-NSE filing; shares continue trading as MASK. Watch hearing timing and any reverse split or financing remedy.
